pool-config-preparation.title: Prepare Pool project configuration
pool-config-preparation.intro: Combine existing machine-side files into a new Pool configuration. Only paths and public identifiers are entered here.
pool-config-preparation.field.base_commi: Fixed commit · 40 or 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
pool-config-preparation.output_help: Choose a new file in an existing directory. Existing files are never overwritten. Changing a running configuration requires a new file and a new state directory; preserve the old execution journal.
pool-config-preparation.scope_help: Choose from the loaded approved Grant metadata, or explicitly enter IDs. This is not the complete project catalog and does not grant access. Current bilateral project authorization is still required.
pool-config-preparation.manual_ids: Enter tenant and project IDs manually
pool-config-preparation.grant_unavailabl: The selected approval is not currently available. Select a current approval or explicitly switch to manual identifiers.
pool-config-preparation.commands_help: Leave the commands file empty to configure the workspace first; no tools are enabled. File contents are read only on the target machine.
pool-config-preparation.advanced_help: Repository and commit must be provided together. Enter only paths to existing private files; never paste model keys, command definitions or credentials.
pool-config-preparation.copy_failed: Copy failed. Select and copy the displayed command manually.
pool-config-preparation.command: Run explicitly on the target machine
pool-config-preparation.boundary: This draft stays in this window and is cleared when its scope changes or it closes. Copying does not run scripts, start a Worker, discover tools or change a Grant. The native CLI validates actual files; current runtime identity, authorizations and tool readiness remain separate.
pool-config-preparation.unavailable: Read the current authorized Pool and active registered node before preparing a configuration.
pool-config-preparation.issue.target: Choose the target shell and a new absolute output path.
pool-config-preparation.issue.slots: Slots must be an integer within the current node limit.
pool-config-preparation.issue.scope_id: Scope {{row}}: enter valid tenant and project identifiers.
pool-config-preparation.issue.duplicate: Scope {{row}} duplicates an existing tenant/project pair.
pool-config-preparation.issue.path: Scope {{row}}: use unambiguous absolute paths on the target machine.
pool-config-preparation.issue.baseline: Scope {{row}}: supply repository and a lowercase 40/64-character commit together, or leave both empty.
pool-config-preparation.issue.too_large: The preparation input exceeds 64 KiB. Use fewer scopes or shorter references.
pool-config-preparation.scope_changed: Project scope changed; reselect local files.
pool-config-preparation.diagnostic.title: Preparation failed?
pool-config-preparation.diagnostic.intro: Paste one diagnostic JSON line from the native CLI (up to 4 KiB), then explicitly locate the problem. This does not read files or run checks.
pool-config-preparation.diagnostic.impor: Imported report, not a live check.
pool-config-preparation.diagnostic.outpu: Only the current output path is associated. The report did not bind a complete input, so no project field is located.
pool-config-preparation.diagnostic.error: Paste one valid diagnostic line with the supported protocol and fields, at most 4 KiB.
This report does not match the current input or output references. Keep the original operation and use its exact current draft.
This browser cannot verify the report references. Use a browser context with Web Crypto available.
pool-config-preparation.diagnostic.advic: Review the original preparation input and its size before explicitly trying again.
Review the exact output path on the target machine.
Verify the existing output directory and its permissions on the target machine.
The output already exists. Inspect and preserve that file; preparation never overwrites it.
The file may already have been written. Reconcile the original output before retrying; do not assume the write failed.
Verify the indicated existing directory on the target machine.
Review the indicated workspace boundary and project mapping.
Verify that the indicated private source file is accessible on the target machine.
Review the indicated private file format on the target machine. Do not paste its contents here.
The original input files changed. Preserve them and review the current references before trying again.
Review the original combined configuration against the existing Pool configuration contract.
Preparation was canceled. Reconcile the original output before explicitly trying again.
